gates.criteria: Zero unreviewed CVEs in third-party libraries; all submodules pinned to immutable commit hashes.
Bytecode matches bit-for-bit in clean hermetic container; zero contracts violate EIP-170 or EIP-3860 size boundaries.
Zero unsuppressed static warnings; 100% of suppression entries cryptographically signed and structurally valid.
Zero missing events on state-modifying functions; all primary entity identifiers correctly indexed.
Zero storage collision warnings; formal confirmation of initializer protection and facet selector uniqueness.
100% pass across all applicable reference standard compliance suites.
All unit, differential, and fork tests pass; coverage meets >= 95% threshold with all gap justifications approved.
Zero unauthorized callers can execute privileged state-modifying functions; 100% concordance between declared matrix and executable tests.
Mutation kill rate meets or exceeds 90%; zero unaddressed live mutants in core accounting logic.
Zero invariant violations after target runs and depth across all active fuzzing engines.
All bounded paths proven safe; zero unmitigated bytecode vulnerabilities reported by Mythril/Halmos.
Zero failed Kontrol proofs; coverage thresholds met on all proven rules; zero undocumented vacuous proofs.
Signed cryptographic approval by Principal Security Engineer certifying threat model coverage, invariant completeness, and suppression justifications.
All signed attestations, verifiable build hashes, active suppression tables, and execution logs committed to public repository root.
